outcome: natural log of strictly positive recorded impressions
split_rule: first 60% train, next 20% calibration, final 20% test, chronological
calibration_score: absolute residual on calibration observations only
exchangeability_caveat: Chronological data may violate exchangeability; the algorithm uses a valid separate calibration set and finite-sample order statistic, but the usual marginal coverage guarantee requires calibration and test examples to be exchangeable.
